fix(codeon): redact DB URL query in live reports

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-1
  description: |-
    Live-e2e report.json previously kept PostgreSQL URL query parameters after stripping userinfo, so secrets in sslmode-adjacent or password= query fields could leak into recovery data. Rebuild the redacted endpoint from scheme, host, port, and database path only, and cover query/fragment stripping with a regression test.
